issue_context.title: PVS-Studio: Confusing if-else statement in Orleans.Interner.InternCacheCleanupTimerCallback method

review_comments:
I think this statement was meant to be executed if condition `logger.IsVerbose` is false, and not if `numRemoved > 0` is false.
hmmm, not sure @dVakulen since that wouldn't make a lot of sense. If IsVerbose is false, then IsVerbose2 will certainly be false. I think that if numRemoved == 0 it was logging as Verbose2
I think the intention is like I coded it. If something was removed, log at Verbose, if nothing was removed (less interesting event), log at Verbose2. The `if(logger.IsVerbose)` is there instead of compile time #IFDEF.
I see. Before the fix the `Verbose2` log statement was never called.
